title: Synthetic QMS-017 SiC gate-oxide excursion containment
content: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. If dynamic gate-oxide leakage exceeds the control limit on two consecutive wafers, quarantine all lots sharing epitaxy batch, implant recipe, oxidation furnace window, and final-test handler. Open an 8D within two hours, notify automotive quality and account teams within four hours, and prohibit customer shipment until reliability engineering signs the containment record.

title: Synthetic SCM-042 automotive allocation and alternate-source protocol
content: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Preserve safety-stock commitments for launch-phase automotive programs. Reallocate unaffected finished goods only after lot genealogy and electrical-screen equivalence are confirmed. Record every customer allocation decision with order, product, lot, plant, and approver identifiers.

title: Synthetic COMMS-009 customer incident communications
content: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Initial external communication must distinguish confirmed facts, working hypotheses, and next verification time. Never disclose another customer, internal yield, or unapproved root-cause theory. Teams updates are drafts until an incident commander explicitly approves sending.
